dir.review.terms: Important Terms: All ledger entries are non-refundable and hold zero formal entitlements. Ensure your configurations are accurate before generating your listing metadata. Network problems or visibility challenges must be escalated straight to the Dewrito Staff Team.

contact.reporting.body: If you use your Matrix client to report remote users, only dewrito.net will receive the report. For comprehensive reports, please include as much detail as possible — usernames, timestamps, room context, and screenshots if available.

features.label: What We Offer
features.title: Built by the community, for the community.
features.matrix.title: Matrix Chat
features.matrix.body: Host your own chat server on the open Matrix protocol. Full control, full privacy, no vendor lock-in.
features.fluxer.title: Fluxer Client
features.fluxer.body: Real-time chat, voice calls, and screen sharing all self-hosted. The privacy-first alternative to Discord.
features.community.title: Open Community
features.community.body: Just a community keeping infrastructure running for everyone.
community.label: Community Hub
community.title: Join the #dewrito space
community.body: The Matrix protocol is open, federated, and privacy-respecting. Our official #dewrito space on matrix.dewrito.net is where the community connects, shares information, and coordinates — all on infrastructure we control.
support.label: Sustain the Infrastructure
support.title: Help keep the servers running.
support.body: Our infrastructure is community-funded and community-maintained. Every contribution helps us keep the Matrix homeserver, Fluxer deployment, and all services online for everyone.
register.title: Choose Your Client
register.intro: By registering you agree to our Terms of Service. We allow registrations from certain email service providers; if you'd like your provider whitelisted, please contact us to request whitelisting.
register.check.label: Check your email provider
register.matrix.body: The open, decentralized communication protocol. Full control, end-to-end encryption, and federation across servers.
register.matrix.pro1: Decentralized & federated — no single company controls it
register.matrix.pro2: End-to-end encryption available in private rooms
register.matrix.pro3: Interoperable with Discord, IRC via bridges
register.matrix.con1: Can feel slow in large rooms or on low-end devices
register.matrix.con4: Joining the right rooms can be tricky for beginners
register.fluxer.body: A Discord-like experience with strong privacy. Channels, roles, voice/video calls, screen sharing — all self-hosted.
register.fluxer.pro3: Lightweight & fast — smoother than heavy clients
register.fluxer.pro4: Good community tools: roles, permissions, audit logs
register.fluxer.con1: Newer product (~2026) — still maturing in polish
register.fluxer.con3: No federation yet — rooms don't federate across instances
register.support.title: Help keep the servers running
register.support.body: Our infrastructure is community-funded. Every contribution matters.
